niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers high-contrast, structured interfaces with strong grouping, visible hierarchy, rounded cards, and either dark navy tech-forward themes or clean bright layouts when they improve clarity. They repeatedly favor screens that make organization obvious through modular cards, grouped sections, clear navigation, and prominent actions. They often like richer information density when it is well-structured, but reject clutter, weak hierarchy, or decorative noise. They also consistently respond well to polished modern styling such as rounded containers, filled surfaces, vivid but controlled cool accents, and clear content previews.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers modular card-based layouts, clearly separated sections, grouped content, and contained panels instead of loose continuous pages, weak grouping, or fragmented structure.
Prefers clear hierarchy with prominent focal elements, labeled sections, separated field labels, strong section titles, and obvious organization of primary vs secondary content.

Prefers higher-contrast themes—most often dark navy interfaces with white text/cards and cool blue or purple accents, though sometimes bright light themes are preferred when they increase clarity and contrast over muted alternatives.
Prefers rounded cards, tiles, pills, and softened container shapes with clear surface separation rather than flat rows, square panels, or weakly defined containers.

Prefers visible app bars, bottom navigation, labeled controls, integrated primary actions, anchored action areas, and obvious completion/share/selection affordances over hidden, minimal, or ambiguous actions.

Often prefers denser, feature-rich screens with more controls, metrics, or content visible at once when they are cleanly organized; in some contexts also prefers simplification over clutter, indicating density is liked when structure remains strong.
Prefers fewer distractions, less decorative noise, subdued or abstract backgrounds, cleaner copy presentation, and interfaces that reduce competing elements while preserving clarity.
